name: Claude Connector
short_description: Connect ServiceNow to the Anthropic Claude API (IBM Services Essentials) with a streaming chat UI.
description: A scoped application that replicates the claude-webapp-dotenv Python/Flask app inside ServiceNow. It provides a Service Portal widget and a UI Page with a streaming chat interface that calls the Anthropic Messages API via IBM Services Essentials, manages per-session conversation history, and supports system prompts, model selection, prefill, and stop sequences.
